name: Scott Marshall

roles.organization: The Select Group (under Amentum),  Camp Smith, HI
roles.title: J326 AI Lead and Data Engineering / Science / Architecture
paragraphs: Work as a developer and technical liaison for USINDOPACOM Joint Fires Division.  Created, installed, enriched, tested agents, models, and applications on several networks for the Joint Fires Division.
Coordinated with several development teams to analyze how AI/ Data could improve the Targeting Cycle, Weaponeering Process, Assessments, Collections, and Order of Effects.
Worked alongside operators in the Joint Fires Center and Joint Operations Center to provide training and support for AI tools and applications.

Evaluated AI tools developed for J2/J3 organizations and reported capabilities and potential use cases to leadership.  Translated leadership priorities into technical requirements for developers and engineers across J2, J3, J4, CDAO, and JFN organizations.
This required in-depth technical understanding of the following:
bullets: Prompt Engineering, Tool-Calling, and how to structure a complex Agentic System
Network to Network Capabilities and Synchronization
Weaponeering tools like JTCG/ME’s Sims and Physics-Based Tools, Capability Assessment, CSP’s, Non-Kinetic Effects
Military Doctrine and Structure for Planning and Messaging
Joint Fires Network: Jupyter Notebooks, Python SDKs and Libraries, Local Model Installation and Tuning
Models and AI Tools: Palantir/Maven, GenAI, Compass AI, Scale, Clairvoyant, Nebula, ChatGPT, Starshield (Grok), Claude
J-Series Message Traffic: Parsing, Binning, Combining for Players, Tracks, Platforms, Events and reflecting these changes
Data Sources: Blue and Red Object Ontologies, ADVANA, MARS, ATOMS,  MRI (Munitions Readiness Initiative), UMAMI, Logistics
